meaning: Public-safe identities of explicitly Owner-authorized semantic decisions, including a decision pass the Project Owner explicitly delegated to an identified reviewer (its approver and binding say so). Each decision approves exact claim revisions and digests; semantic approval is separate from executed behaviour verification. Its full record is private (the project's steward repository). A claim is approved only through an entry here that names its revision and digest; a reviewed date or a passing build is not an approval.

decisions.binding: The Project Owner explicitly delegated this semantic decision pass to the managing reviewer. The reviewer accepted the six listed normative revisions/digests at their stated source/contract applicability. This records delegated acceptance, not direct human review of each digest or a fresh test result. Changed meanings, applicability or normative examples require a new revision and approval; implementation defects cannot become verified through approval.

decisions.summary: Accept the 17 reviewed Claude stream-json canonical conformance entries as one batch at their documented source/version/route scopes: seven usage rules (one response's reported tranches, result-reported run usage, the last response's final usage at the reviewed one-message iteration shape, model-keyed cumulative usage, the Agent result as the child's last metered response, the task-progress and task-notification tracker measures), three duration/status rules (reported run duration, the child's reported status and duration), three cost/capacity rules (per-model cumulative USD cost with the most-recent-request pricing basis, context-window and output-limit capacities as configuration limits) and four vendor_specific residual classifications (the thinking-token estimate and its delta, the tool_use_result totalTokens derivation, the reviewed message-iteration detail).
decisions.record: private steward decision record: review of the 17 pending Claude canonical approvals (2026-10-31) and its proposed-approvals appendix at steward commit 31c3a32, accepted by the Owner on 2026-10-31
decisions.binding: Approves exactly the 13 obligation revisions at their current meaning and relevant digests and the 4 residual classifications at their digests, as frozen in claude-stream-usage-baseline 0.6 at project 066eb63 (catalog schema/vendor/claude-code/stream-json/obligations.json 0.5). It does not turn estimates or conditional values into measured usage, permit overlapping usage observations, resolve unreviewed iteration shapes or unknown units, admit any route, or approve mapping-catalog claims, Java expected-fact meanings or the broader correction groups. A changed meaning or a changed relevant definition or rule needs a new revision and a new decision.
